title: The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.24 does not sanitise and escape some of its staff member settings before…
description: The Live Composer WordPress plugin versions before 2.1.24 contain a vulnerability where some staff member settings are not properly sanitized and escaped before being output on pages. This flaw allows high-privilege users, such as administrators, to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks even if the unfiltered_html capability is disabled, such as in multisite WordPress setups.
